fields.name: GenerationIdOrMemberEpoch
fields.about: The generation of the group if using the classic group protocol or the member epoch if using the consumer protocol.

fields.name: MemberId
fields.about: The member ID assigned by the group coordinator.

fields.name: GroupInstanceId
fields.about: The unique identifier of the consumer instance provided by end user.

fields.name: RetentionTimeMs
fields.about: The time period in ms to retain the offset.

fields.name: Topics
fields.about: The topics to commit offsets for.

fields.name: Partitions
fields.about: Each partition to commit offsets for.

fields.name: CommittedOffset
fields.about: The message offset to be committed.

fields.name: CommittedLeaderEpoch
fields.about: The leader epoch of this partition.

fields.name: CommittedMetadata
fields.about: Any associated metadata the client wants to keep.
